references.text: The Philistine rulers asked Delilah to find out the secret behind Samson's strength, which is now fulfilled as he reveals everything to her.
The preceding verse where Samson finally tells Delilah the whole truth about his strength, leading to her action in this verse.
The consequence of Delilah's betrayal: Samson loses his strength and is captured by the Philistines.
The Philistine rulers also gather in connection with the temple of Dagon, the same group of leaders mentioned here.
An example of money being used as a bribe to achieve betrayal, just as the Philistine rulers paid Delilah.
Judas receives money to betray Jesus, a parallel to how Delilah received silver to betray Samson.
